name: Weather Bicycle Riding Through a City
description: An empty bicycle glides through a quiet cobblestone street while miniature storms and sunny clouds swirl inside its wheels.
prompt: A single imaginative image of an empty vintage bicycle gliding by itself through a quiet cobblestone city street at blue hour. Inside the two wheels, miniature weather systems swirl: one tiny thunderstorm, one tiny sunny cloud bank. Rain droplets fall only around the left wheel, small sunbeams shine from the right wheel, wet reflections on stone, dreamlike realism, no text, no logos, no watermark.
caption: Some rides carry their own weather.
